# Project harness backlog

Current work ledger, reviewed 14 November 2026 against main `f209f34` (PRs #172–#173, green CI). Full audit 2026-11-14 opened B-020, F-078 and F-079; F-075 and F-077 open. History: [reconciliation log](archive/reconciliation-2026.md).

<!-- totals:start -->
<!-- totals:end -->

## Work items

Bugs (B-) and features (F-) in one list, most urgent first.

## Other changes Earlier release notes (v2.2.2 – v4.7.0) are archived in [Reconciliation log](archive/reconciliation-2026.md#archived-other-changes-moved-from-backlogmd-on-2026-11-13). ## How to use this file | Status | Requirements | Next statuses and conditions | Priority cue | |---|---|---|---| | **🔴 Open** | Reproducible bug or agreed capability; scope and next action recorded. | - **Investigate** if cause/scope is uncertain
- **Implemented** when code is complete
- **Blocked** if a named dependency prevents progress
- **Closed** if cancelled/superseded, with reason. | Coloured | | **🟠 Investigate** | Report and unanswered question recorded; next diagnostic identified. | - **Open** when scope/cause is established
- **Implemented** when fixed
- **Blocked** if evidence/dependency is unavailable
- **Closed** if duplicate/not reproducible after documented investigation, with reason. | Coloured | | **🟡 Implemented** | Code exists; required verification remains pending. | - **Verified** when all acceptance checks pass (automated ones: the merged PR's green CI run)
- Open or Investigate if a check fails
- **Blocked** if a required check cannot proceed. | Coloured | | **🟢 Verified** | All acceptance checks passed; date, method and evidence recorded, including human/device checks when required. | - **Closed** when no action remains and resolution is recorded
- **Open** or **Investigate** if new evidence invalidates verification. Do not leave completed items here indefinitely. | Coloured | | **🟣 Blocked** | Specific blocker, affected work/check and resume condition recorded. | - Return to **Open**, **Investigate** or **Implemented** when unblocked
- **Verified** only after all checks pass
- **Closed** if cancelled/superseded, with reason. | Grey ◻️ | | **🔵 Closed** | Resolution recorded and item archived. | - **Open** or **Investigate** if reopened by new evidence
Retain ID, original Opened date and historical closure record. | Grey ◻️ | Follow [Backlog rules](BACKLOG-RULES.md) for updating records, reconciling PR/CI evidence, stale-state review, closure/archiving, human dependencies and table validation. Preserve stable IDs and existing user edits. Each item shows its ID and title, a summary table (status with its colour, priority, effort size, remaining time, Depends on, Unlocks and Procedures and Decisions, 🧑 where the record or one of its ready steps waits on that kind of human action), the human or next action, and Issue / Reproduce / Check. Expand the closed details for next actions, estimate rationale, PR history, dates and verification. Effort, from the remaining agent hours (owner time apart): 🟢 Small ≤1 h · 🟡 Medium ≤4 h · 🔴 Large ≤8 h · 🟣 Very large more; work still estimated in days: 🟢 Small ≤1 day · 🟡 Medium 2–3 days · 🔴 Large ≥4 days. Status and verification evidence describe progress; effort is an estimate of work still required. A `---` line ends every item.
